## [1.2.0](https://github.com/trulow/sync-reddit-fixes/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0) (2026-10-30)

### ✨ New Features

* Add Fix Redgifs API patch for Sync and Sync Pro ([97f8961](https://github.com/trulow/sync-reddit-fixes/commit/97f89616e34a68438032159e480e3377f76d2b26)), closes [wchill/patcheddit#100](https://github.com/wchill/patcheddit/issues/100)

patches.name: Fix Reddit galleries
patches.description: Fixes Reddit image galleries failing to load ("Could not load gallery") since Reddit blocked /api/info for third-party clients. Galleries are loaded from /comments instead.

patches.name: Fix Redgifs API
patches.description: Fixes "Error connecting to Redgifs": answers the Redgifs endpoints Sync relies on that were removed, uses Redgifs' temporary token, and fixes video ids taken from links like redgifs.com/watch/{id}/?92. Works on Sync and Sync Pro. Turn off Patcheddit's "Fix Redgifs API" when using this one: both change the same code.

patches.name: Fix load more comments
patches.description: Fixes "Error loading more comments" since Reddit blocked /api/morechildren for third-party clients. The missing comments are loaded from /comments instead. At the bottom of very large threads Reddit's 500 comment limit can still leave some out.

patches.name: Fix Reddit galleries
patches.description: Fixes Reddit image galleries failing to load ("Could not load gallery") since Reddit blocked /api/info for third-party clients. Galleries are loaded from /comments instead.

patches.name: Fix Redgifs API
patches.description: Fixes "Error connecting to Redgifs": answers the Redgifs endpoints Sync relies on that were removed, uses Redgifs' temporary token, and fixes video ids taken from links like redgifs.com/watch/{id}/?92. Works on Sync and Sync Pro. Turn off Patcheddit's "Fix Redgifs API" when using this one: both change the same code.

patches.description: Fixes "Error loading more comments" since Reddit blocked /api/morechildren for third-party clients. The missing comments are loaded from /comments instead. At the bottom of very large threads Reddit's 500 comment limit can still leave some out.
